summary: The checked-out source still contains the reported unknown-model registration path. The upstream draft candidate PR #37555 rejects that registration under IGW, but its recovery claim depends on periodic reconciliation PR #32322, which is not present at this base and remains open. The prepared image also has neither cargo nor a prebuilt gateway binary, so the actual Rust implementation and a failing-before/passing-after regression could not be executed. No incomplete source fix was committed.

tests.what_was_measured: Attempted to compile and run a regression over the real CreateLocalWorkerStep; the shell reported cargo: command not found before compilation. The temporary test was removed after recording the blocker.
Verified that the exact head commit of upstream periodic reconciliation PR #32322 is not an ancestor of the prepared base.

tests.command: source inspection: create_worker.rs, local/mod.rs, service_discovery.rs, router selection call sites, and upstream PRs #37555/#32322
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed that empty discovered metadata falls back to UNKNOWN_MODEL_ID; discover_metadata continues on failure; IGW selects by requested model; tracked pods deduplicate later events; and this base has no periodic LIST/resubmit implementation.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reported gateway control-plane path requires no model or GPU. No GPU claim is made.

remaining_limitations: The real Rust gateway could not be compiled or run because cargo is absent from the prepared image and no prebuilt gateway executable was found.
No Kubernetes service-discovery reproduction was run.
Upstream draft PR #37555 alone is not a complete fix on this base: rejecting registration leaves the pod in tracked_pods, while the periodic recovery path in upstream PR #32322 is absent.
No failing-before/passing-after executable regression is claimed.
